Lot of big words I don't understand but it looks great!

Hey MatSix, I believe you are confused here... xD First, whitelist is ONLY for avatars. There is no restrictions on Unity or VRC supported asset components for worlds. Only custom scripts are not allowed. Second, what you actually would need, is VRChat to implement the entire asset you are using, to be a part of the VRChat API standard, much the same way VRChat implemented full support for Dynamic Bone asset. This makes this request a much huger request, as adding an asset to VRC is a tall order, one which is rarely ever fulfilled for various reasons, including the fact that every asset you add, is a potential for VRC to need to debug it when things go wrong, or the risk when the asset is no longer supported, having all the old content that relied on it breaking, etc. For this reason it is really rare that VRC will add assets with custom scripts as part of the standard game. Usually only Unity made scripts such as the Post Process stack have a higher chance of being added to the core API.

I know this isn't what you want to hear... trust me, if VRC would add random asset requests, the community has TONS of amazing assets (that require the custom scripts added to the core game) that would be great additions. This is actually a topic of debate we had back about 2-3 years ago with some of the veterans and the devs, it's something that would be really nice, but also has too many drawbacks atm. 

By the way, a potential work around is to model your terrain as an actual mesh, instead of a Unity terrain object, then you can put a standard shader on the mesh instead, giving you access to all those features you just mentioned. Of course a terrain will use a splatmap... for that you'd need a custom shader which can get pretty advanced... But there are options.

@{58c6d558ff44e44ada717902|full_name}: I've looked into it a bit more and there's a paid asset called megasplat made by the same guy which works in VRChat. Only problem is it's $50 and from the bit I've messed with it, it is a lot more complex and complicated than microsplat.

@{5a775c36cc2ae94352f56efa|full_name}: For anyone thinking of purchasing Megasplat, it does not work with VRChat - the shader gives nothing but a white texture in game. Microsplat works... sort of, triplanar mapping doesn't show - can't speak for the other addons. A real shame as I've wasted a lot of money and time -_-'
I would love to see some sort of support added for either Micro or Megasplat, the results achievable are fantastic for the computational cost

I know this is an old post but would love to see the support for all Jason Booth tools. It would be incredible to have these whitelisted for world creation for making terrain and vegetation creation simpler rather than limiting the toolset.

details:
This is just a matter of adding something to whitelist. It's a simple terrain script which adds more variety to terrains and can help make some great looking worlds. I actually messed around with it and I made some really awesome looking stuff.

One of the main things it adds is per texture control. So you can add specular, tessellation, change albedo tint, brightness, and other stuff.

BIG NOTE: There are paid modules, tessellation being one of them. But people can pick and choose which is nice.

Please consider adding this since it is just a matter of whitelisting.

Asset: https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/tools/terrain/microsplat-96478

-Request by Matsix, the killer loli that enjoys making pretty maps on the side

P.S. I attached a photo to show what it can do, the rocks in the water is actually a terrain texture with tessellation, the moss is too.
